pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

12. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

10. D — Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Map Reading and Interpretation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
